DB-03-monthly.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month',date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM commerce.sales WHERE date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

DB-03-total.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM commerce.sales WHERE date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND date < DATE '2027-01-01'

DB-11.sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS distinct_orders FROM commerce.orders o JOIN commerce.order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN commerce.products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.order_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date<DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

DB-13.sql: SELECT i.snapshot_date,i.category,SUM(i.stock_on_hand) AS stock_on_hand FROM commerce.inventory i WHERE i.snapshot_date IN (SELECT DISTINCT snapshot_date FROM commerce.inventory ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 3) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

DB-20-monthly.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month',date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM commerce.sales WHERE date>=DATE '2026-07-01' AND date<DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

DB-20-total.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM commerce.sales WHERE date>=DATE '2026-07-01' AND date<DATE '2026-10-01'

DB-22-source-coverage.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS joined_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS recorded_distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories FROM commerce.orders o LEFT JOIN commerce.order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN commerce.products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.order_date>=DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date<DATE '2027-01-01'
